Process.title: International Patient Journey
Process.subtitle: We are with you at every step, from application to discharge.

steps.s1Body: Reach us via WhatsApp or the form and share your test results and imaging.
steps.s2Body: The team reviews your file; a video consultation is scheduled if needed.
steps.s3Body: You receive a tailored treatment plan, price range and package details.
steps.s4Body: Transfers, accommodation and interpreter are arranged; your treatment takes place.
steps.s5Body: Your recovery is monitored with online check-ups after discharge.

Process.packagesBody: Our packages include accommodation, airport transfers and medical interpreter service. The final price is given after assessment, based on treatment and length of stay.
Process.visaBody: Citizens of many countries can enter Türkiye visa-free or with an e-visa. Once your appointment is confirmed, we support you with an invitation letter and travel documents if needed.
Process.visaDisclaimer: Visa requirements vary by country; check current official sources.
